title: Nato confirms drone sighting near Ukrainian plane at German airport after ‘security incident’ – Europe live
summary_full: German police had earlier said they were investigating ‘unidentified flying object’ disrupting flights in LeipzigFor what it’s worth, DHL Group CEO Tobias Meyer said the German logistics firm was studying ​the overnight incident which also involved an object clashing with one of its planes near Leipzig.“We’ve ‌got plans for cases ​like this, and ​we’ll try to make sure that the influence on our customers will be as low as possible,” Meyer said during a quarterly results call earlier this morning, Reuters reported.
